info.title: Coldcat backend API
info.description: Content, observation and disk-management API. Imports run offline with the server stopped. GETs are read-only. IDs, counts and bytes are decimal strings. Only complete inventories are visible.

get.summary: Browse immediate child directories in a complete snapshot
get.description: Root is the empty path and exists even for a zero-file inventory. Directories are inferred from file paths. Paths are case-sensitive valid UTF-8 with / separators, no absolute paths, trailing separators, empty nonroot segments, or dot/parent-traversal segments. Long imported paths remain browsable; cursors use stable IDs and a filter digest. Backslashes and glob characters are literal. Missing directories and incomplete snapshots return 404. Sort by binary path and entry kind. Keep parameters and limit unchanged when following cursors. Successful imports invalidate cursors; unchanged restarts, recovery and failed imports preserve them. Unknown/repeated/empty parameters are rejected except parent.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are allowed

get.summary: Read recursive directory sizes and current redundancy
get.description: Membership belongs to the requested complete snapshot, including historical snapshots. File bytes count repeated content at each path; unique-content bytes count each identity once. Unknown sizes are reported separately and known zero is complete. Sizes reflect successful shared-content enrichment from later imports. max_known_mtime is reported metadata, null when unavailable. The histogram weights descendant file occurrences by distinct current disks other than the source disk; repeated historical snapshots add no replicas. No inferred directory claims to represent unavailable empty filesystem directories or allocation sizes.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are allowed

get.summary: Page immediate files/directories or recursive files
get.description: Binary path then kind ordering; directory precedes file at equal paths. recursive=true lists descendant files only. Replica bounds filter files against the whole current catalog; immediate child directories remain navigation entries. Historical source files remain selectable, with current other counts excluding their source disk/location only when present. Metric defaults to disks. Exact bounds cannot combine with range bounds. Preserve all filters and limit when following cursors. Source snapshot, revision, current status and applied filters are explicit. Paths follow the directory browsing contract. Missing directories return 404.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are allowed

get.description: Compares the requested complete-snapshot directory with directories in each disk's latest complete snapshot. Relative file paths and content identities must match; root names and mtimes are ignored. Unfiltered fingerprints select candidates, but canonical manifests are verified. Filters are applied symmetrically and block rules take precedence. Paths use / on every platform. Doublestar v4 syntax is supported: *, **, ?, character classes, alternatives and backslash escaping. Matching is case-sensitive. Empty filtered comparisons return no replicas. Sort by disk ID, root path and directory ID. Successful imports invalidate cursors.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are allowed

get.summary: Page content coverage on other disks
get.description: For each other disk's latest complete snapshot, reports how many selected source file occurrences and distinct contents exist anywhere on that disk. Destination names and paths do not matter. Source-disk results are excluded. Known and unknown source byte counts remain separate. Uses the same case-sensitive doublestar allow/block selection as directory replicas. Empty filtered comparisons return no disk rows. Sort by disk ID; successful imports invalidate cursors.

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are allowed

get.summary: Search observations by filename or disk-relative path
get.description: Exact and substring matching are case-sensitive, literal and exhaustive. Name means the final /-separated segment; path means the entire disk-relative path. No normalization, trimming or wildcard interpretation is applied. Rank exact selected-field matches before prefixes before other substrings, then original path in binary order, then observation ID ascending. History includes repeated observations and visibly marks historical results. Counts remain catalog-wide despite membership filters. Snapshot filters restrict scope: an older snapshot returns no current results, and requires history to search its observations. Keep all applied filters and limit unchanged when following a cursor. Successful imports invalidate cursors; unchanged restart, recovery and failed imports preserve them. Unknown, repeated and empty parameters are rejected except directory. Fuzzy matching is not yet implemented.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Nonempty valid UTF-8 literal text, at most 1024 bytes, no NUL. Whitespace is significant.

parameters.name: snapshot_id
parameters.description: Complete snapshot. Must belong to disk_id when both are supplied.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.description: Requires disk_id or snapshot_id. Case-sensitive disk-relative directory; / separates segments. No leading/trailing slash, empty nonroot segments, . or ..; maximum 1024 bytes. Literal wildcard characters and segment boundaries are preserved. Empty means root. Missing directories return an empty page.

parameters.name: other_replicas
parameters.description: Exact current count minus one. Requires current scope; cannot combine with min/max bounds.

parameters.name: min_other_replicas
parameters.description: Inclusive minimum current count minus one. Requires current scope.

parameters.name: max_other_replicas
parameters.description: Inclusive maximum current count minus one. Requires current scope; must be at least minimum.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page

200.description: Ranked search page with applied filters, revision and replica summaries

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are allowed

get.summary: List distinct contents with current redundancy filters
get.description: Ordered by content ID ascending. Disk/directory filters select membership; counts remain catalog-wide. Current scope includes only currently present content. History includes contents from all complete inventories. Replica bounds require current scope; exact bounds cannot be combined with range bounds. Keep normalized filters and limit unchanged when following a cursor. Successful offline imports invalidate cursors; unchanged restarts, failed imports and recovery preserve them. Unknown, repeated and empty parameters are rejected except directory, whose empty value means root. Missing disks return 404; missing directories return an empty page.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.description: Requires disk_id. Case-sensitive disk-relative directory, with / separators, no leading/trailing slash or . or .. segments. Maximum 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Descendant segment boundaries and literal wildcard characters are preserved. Empty means root.

parameters.name: other_replicas
parameters.description: Exact current count minus one; cannot combine with min/max bounds.

parameters.name: min_other_replicas
parameters.description: Inclusive minimum current count minus one.

parameters.name: max_other_replicas
parameters.description: Inclusive maximum current count minus one; must be at least the minimum.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page

200.description: Content page with applied filters and catalog revision

405.description: Only GET and HEAD are allowed

get.summary: Look up an exact algorithm/hash identity
get.description: Different algorithms never establish equivalence. Hex is case-insensitive on input, lowercase on output. Accepts the hash lengths currently accepted by the importer.

get.summary: Read content and scoped replica counts
Page through current locations or historical observations
get.description: Ordered by observation ID ascending. Current uses the latest complete inventory of each disk by (captured_at,id). History includes repeated observations; location_count instead deduplicates disk/path pairs. Keep content ID, scope and limit unchanged when following a cursor. Revision is the highest completed snapshot ID, or 0. Successful publication invalidates cursors; restart, empty-disk creation and failed-import cleanup preserve them. Cursors are for the issuing catalog. Unknown, empty and repeated scalar parameters are rejected.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page

200.description: Observation page; historical-only content has an empty current list

409.description: Inventory changed since the cursor was issued; restart pagination

error.message: cursor belongs to a different inventory revision

get.summary: Read an observation, inventory and disk with other current replica counts
get.description: Other counts exclude the observation's disk/path or disk only where currently present for that content. Historical-only contents have zero other replicas. Embedded content uses current scope.

get.summary: List disk metadata and latest complete inventories
get.description: Disk ID ascending. Keep limit unchanged when following a cursor. The first page fixes the maximum disk ID; disks created later are excluded from that traversal. Metadata edits appear as currently stored on each page and do not invalidate cursors. Successful offline imports invalidate cursors; unchanged restarts and failed imports preserve them. This is not a historical metadata snapshot. Unknown, repeated and empty parameters are rejected.

post.description: Requires a unique case-sensitive nonempty label and capacity as a decimal string in the range 0..9223372036854775807. Optional notes/serial may be omitted, null or empty. Unknown fields, trailing JSON values and query parameters are rejected. Body maximum 65536 bytes; Content-Type must be application/json.

get.summary: Read disk metadata and cataloged size completeness
get.description: Latest complete inventory by (captured_at,id). Cataloged bytes sum known content sizes per file path, including repeated contents. Unknown sizes are counted separately. These are inventory subtotals, not measured disk usage/free space. A disk without an inventory has null latest_snapshot and cataloged; a complete empty inventory has zero counts and size_complete=true. Size-sum overflow is an explicit server error. No query parameters are accepted.

patch.description: Omitted fields remain unchanged. Null or empty notes/serial clear the field; label/capacity cannot be null. Empty requests, unknown fields, trailing JSON values and query parameters are rejected. Labels remain case-sensitive and unique. No inventory/content mutation. Body maximum 65536 bytes; Content-Type must be application/json.

get.summary: Page through a disk's complete inventories
get.description: Ordered by captured_at descending, then snapshot ID descending. Older inventories imported later do not outrank newer captures. Existing disks without complete inventories return an empty page; nonexistent disks return 404. Keep disk ID and limit unchanged when following a cursor. Revision is the highest completed snapshot ID, or 0. A successful offline import on any disk invalidates cursors; unchanged restarts, disk creation, failed imports and removal of incomplete inventories preserve them. Cursors are for the issuing catalog. Unknown, empty and repeated scalar parameters are rejected.

DirectoryPath.name: path
DirectoryPath.description: Omitted or empty means root. Case-sensitive valid UTF-8 disk-relative directory with / separators; long imported directory paths are supported. No absolute paths, traversal or trailing separators; glob characters and backslashes are literal.

DirectoryCursor.name: cursor
DirectoryCursor.description: Opaque next_cursor; preserve filters and limit.

DirectoryAllow.name: allow
DirectoryAllow.description: Repeatable case-sensitive doublestar v4 pattern. With any allow rule, a relative source path must match at least one. Maximum 100 patterns and 1024 UTF-8 bytes per pattern across allow/block, with 16384 bytes total.

DirectoryBlock.name: block
DirectoryBlock.description: Repeatable case-sensitive doublestar v4 pattern. Matching block rules override allow rules.
